concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-grabpay-ios-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 GrabPay iOS Drop-in Sessions/Advanced add-on for Customer Area setup, PayLater delivery/item request data, no extra Drop-in-specific configuration and TEST/live gates; Web-version wording within the iOS guide remains source-qualified.
warnings: The endpoint notes say Web Drop-in v5.0.0 and pre-v5 inside an iOS guide; they are not established iOS SDK/version gates.
PayLater deliveryAddress and lineItems are required by this page; collecting them for Wallet is recommended, not required.
Examples contain blank currency/country/returnUrl placeholders and TEST endpoints, not ready-to-run live payment evidence.
